# ankra_application (Data Source)

Reads one application by id. The counterpart of `ankra application get`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_application" "web" {
  id = "5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10"
}

output "web_is_running" {
  value = data.ankra_application.web.deployment_state == "running"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the application to read.

### Read-Only

- `app_repo_branch` (String) Branch Ankra builds and deploys.
- `app_repo_name` (String) Repository name.
- `app_repo_owner` (String) Repository owner.
- `app_repo_url` (String) Repository URL.
- `container_image_url` (String) Image repository the application's builds publish to.
- `created_at` (String) When the application was registered.
- `deployment_state` (String) Whether the application is running: `running`, `degraded`, `failed`, `deploying`, `not_deployed` or `unknown`.
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `pipeline_source` (String) What builds the application: an Ankra pipeline, the repository's own CI, or nothing yet.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle of the application record: `creating`, `up` or `error`.
